name: wonder-theme
description: Assistant for the Wonder Shopify theme: search the Wonder docs, check known issues and release notes for your theme version, build custom sections that follow Wonder conventions and pass validation, update a customised theme to a new Wonder version without losing changes, and preview changes on an unpublished copy of your store's theme (uses Shopify CLI on your computer; you log in to your store). Connects to the hosted Wonder MCP server (mcp.wonder-theme.com); no Wonder account needed. What you type isn't kept unless you opt in.

interface.shortDescription: Build and fix Wonder Shopify theme stores
interface.longDescription: Answers from the official Wonder theme documentation, checks known issues and workarounds for your Wonder version, builds custom sections that look native to Wonder and pass validation, moves your customisations to new Wonder versions, and can preview changes on an unpublished copy of your store's theme with Shopify CLI (you log in to your store).
defaultPrompt: Create a custom Wonder section with three testimonials and a background image.
My mega menu looks blurred on Wonder 2.5.1. Is this a known issue?
